{{Quote|I never spoke of the money I diverted long ago to buy this moon&mdash;a private sanctum. A ''redoubt''&mdash;where if necessary, I might reconstitute a ''true Covenant''. Not just along my mother's beliefs&mdash;but embracing my father's as well.|[[Lucien Draay]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 35">[[Knights of the Old Republic 35|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 35]]</ref>}}
'''Draay 2''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] purchased by [[Lucien Draay]] should he have had to reconstitute a [[True Covenant]] from his mother [[Krynda Draay]]'s [[Jedi Covenant]]. Many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] lived on the moon by [[3963 BBY]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Master [[B'ink Utrila]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Rennax Omani]] were sent on the moon with a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] in order to find the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]] hidden in an abandoned [[Jedi Temple (Draay 2)|Jedi Temple]] constructed by the True Covenant in a canyon, and to prevent [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] from recovering it.
